# The Rights Foundry Python SDK (rightsfoundry) — complete reference

> Single-file reference for developers and AI agents. Package: PyPI `rightsfoundry` 1.0.0, import `rightsfoundry`.
> Python 3.9–3.14, zero runtime dependencies, fully typed (`py.typed`, `mypy --strict`). License: MIT.
> Repository: https://github.com/therightsfoundry/trf-python · API docs: https://docs.therightsfoundry.com/ ·
> OpenAPI: https://docs.therightsfoundry.com/openapi.yaml · Platform: https://therightsfoundry.com/ ·
> For builders: https://therightsfoundry.com/for-builders · API keys: https://therightsfoundry.com/dashboard/token ·
> Licensing terms: https://therightsfoundry.com/licensing · MCP connector: https://mcp.therightsfoundry.com/mcp

The Rights Foundry (https://therightsfoundry.com/) is music rights infrastructure operated by AudioSocket. It offers
royalty-free music for commercial and creative sync: programmable licensing across 85,000+ tracks of
cleared, human-made music (61,784 original recordings plus instrumental and alternate versions). Developers and AI
systems search the catalog, stream signed MP3 previews and license broadcast-quality WAV masters in one API call.
Calls are paid from a prepaid fiat credit balance, topped up directly or through an optional monthly plan. New
accounts can claim free beta credits (https://therightsfoundry.com/register): promotional welcome credits, granted
when a payment method is saved on the account (not at registration). If they are used up inside the promotion
window, the account moves to the Starter Beta monthly plan unless the user cancels that transition. Current plan and
auto-conversion terms are on https://therightsfoundry.com/.

======================================================================================================================
0. RULES (read these first)
======================================================================================================================

1. Never expose TRF_API_KEY to browsers, mobile apps, client bundles, logs, issues or prompts. It is an account-wide
   secret that can spend the whole balance. Call the API from a server and hand browsers only track metadata and
   signed preview URLs (asset_url).
2. Never send an Authorization header (or any credential, custom header or cookie) to https://assets.therightsfoundry.com.
   The signature in the URL is the authorisation. client.sync_links.download() already does this correctly.
3. Store track IDs, not signed URLs. Every signed URL (asset_url, peak_data_url, download_url) expires 1 hour after
   it was signed. To get a fresh preview, re-fetch the track (charged). To get a fresh WAV link, call
   tracks.sync(id) again, which is free while the original window is still valid.
4. Never hard-code prices. Read the live rate card from client.credits.retrieve().costs (free, unmetered). The
   operator can change any rate without a new API version.
5. Every charged method accepts max_credits= (a client-side cap on the projected cost; nothing is sent if it would be
   exceeded) and timeout= (seconds, 0 < t <= 600). Every typed method also accepts max_retries=, idempotency_key= and
   send_max_credits_header= (section 2, "Per-call options").
6. tracks.sync() is the licence transaction. Agents should get human approval before calling it, and cap it with
   max_credits.
7. Sync licences do NOT grant AI/ML training rights.
8. Print signed URLs only through link.redacted_download_url() / track.redacted_asset_url().
9. In a constructor, api_key=None does NOT fall back to the environment. Only an omitted api_key reads TRF_API_KEY.

======================================================================================================================
1. INSTALL AND CONSTRUCT
======================================================================================================================

    pip install rightsfoundry        # or: uv add rightsfoundry

    import rightsfoundry
    client = rightsfoundry.Client()                       # reads TRF_API_KEY once, at construction
    client = rightsfoundry.Client(api_key=key_from_vault)  # explicit (str or rightsfoundry.Secret)
    client = rightsfoundry.Client(environment="staging")  # https://api-staging.therightsfoundry.com
    public = rightsfoundry.Client.unauthenticated()       # no key: only .health and .sync_links work

    with rightsfoundry.Client() as client: ...            # closes pooled sockets
    async with rightsfoundry.AsyncClient() as client: ... # asyncio; await every method

Client: synchronous, thread-safe; one instance can be shared. AsyncClient: asyncio, task-safe; use one per event loop.
By default AsyncClient runs the same hardened http.client transport in a bounded thread pool (max_connections
workers).

Client / AsyncClient attributes and methods:
- .tracks         TracksResource / AsyncTracksResource (requires a key)
- .taxonomies     TaxonomiesResource (requires a key)
- .credits        CreditsResource (requires a key)
- .health         HealthResource (no key ever sent)
- .sync_links     SyncLinksResource (no key ever sent)
- .config         ClientConfig (immutable, repr redacted)
- .environment    "production" | "staging"
- .base_url       validated API base URL
- .api_key_fingerprint   8 hex chars, the same fingerprint shown on https://therightsfoundry.com/dashboard/token (None if unauthenticated)
- .with_options(**overrides) -> new client sharing the connection pool; re-validates the merged config
- .request(method, path, *, query=None, json=None, options=None, timeout=None, max_credits=None, idempotency_key=None)
    -> parsed JSON, or None for a 204 / empty 2xx body
- .close() / AsyncClient: await .aclose(); both are context managers
- Clients, configs and Secret refuse pickling and copying (TypeError). Use with_options() instead.

Accessing .tracks / .taxonomies / .credits on an unauthenticated() client raises ConfigurationError.

======================================================================================================================
2. METHODS (sync signatures; AsyncClient methods are identical but `async def`, iterators use `async for`)
======================================================================================================================

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Per-call options (accepted by every typed method below)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  tracks.list / iter / get / deep_search / search_similar / sync, taxonomies.list, credits.retrieve and
  health.check / live / ready accept these keywords (omit one to use the client's setting):
    timeout: float                   seconds for this call, 0 < t <= 600
    max_retries: int                 0–10; replaces the client's max_retries for this call (money-safety rules still apply)
    idempotency_key: str             1–255 printable ASCII characters without spaces, sent as Idempotency-Key. With a
                                     key, ambiguous outcomes (408, 502, 504, read-phase connection failures) are
                                     retried even under charged_retry_policy="refund_backed" (section 7)
    send_max_credits_header: bool    with a cap in force, also send X-TRF-Max-Credits: <int cap> (forward-compatible
                                     server-side cap; the API ignores it today)
    max_credits: int                 charged methods only (see rule 5)
  rightsfoundry.CallOptions is a frozen dataclass bundling the same fields:
    CallOptions(timeout=..., max_credits=..., max_retries=..., idempotency_key=..., send_max_credits_header=...)
    (every field is optional)
  client.request(..., options=CallOptions(...)) accepts it.
  String inputs (search, query, filters) are measured in UTF-16 code units, as the server measures them, after
  surrounding whitespace and a leading byte-order mark (U+FEFF) are stripped.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
client.tracks.list(...) -> TrackPage                                    GET /v1/tracks          CHARGED
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    list(*, page: int | None = None, limit: int | None = None,
         search: str | None = None, genre: str | None = None, mood: str | None = None,
         instrument: str | None = None, theme: str | None = None, artist: str | None = None,
         album: str | None = None, vocals: str | None = None, key: str | None = None,
         bpm_min: float | None = None, bpm_max: float | None = None,
         duration_min: float | None = None, duration_max: float | None = None,
         featured: bool | None = None, explicit: bool | None = None, decade: str | None = None,
         id: int | None = None, include_children: bool | None = None,
         sort_by: str | None = None, sort_order: str | None = None,
         max_credits: int | None = None, timeout: float | None = None, max_retries: int | None = None,
         idempotency_key: str | None = None, send_max_credits_header: bool | None = None) -> TrackPage

  Cost key: tracks_list. With a non-empty `search`: page 1 is tracks_search_first_page and page >= 2 is
  tracks_search_next_page. A whitespace-only search is priced as a listing.
  Parameter rules (validated client-side; nothing is sent on failure → ValidationError):
    page              int >= 1 (default 1 server-side)
    limit             int 1–100 (default 20 server-side). >100 is REJECTED client-side, because the server would silently cap it.
    search            str, <= 200 chars after trim, no control chars
    genre/mood/instrument/theme   str <= 100, exact tag match (server lowercases)
    artist/album      str <= 200
    vocals            "instrumental" | "male" | "female" | "any"
    key               str <= 12, musical key such as "A minor" (catalogue data, not a secret)
    bpm_min/bpm_max   number >= 0; bpm_max <= 999; min <= max. Wire names: bpmMin/bpmMax
    duration_min/max  seconds >= 0; duration_max <= 99999; min <= max. Wire: durationMin/durationMax. The server widens windows < 4 s.
    featured/explicit/include_children   bool (wire: includeChildren)
    decade            str <= 10
    id                int 1..999_999_999_999_999 (filter by one track id)
    sort_by           "relevance" | "first_published" | "created_at" | "title" | "artist" | "bpm" | "duration"
                      (default: relevance with search, else first_published desc). Wire: sortBy
    sort_order        "asc" | "desc" (default desc). Wire: sortOrder
  NaN/Infinity are rejected. Unknown keyword arguments raise TypeError. Parameters are sent in a fixed order.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
client.tracks.iter(...) -> SyncPageIterator  (AsyncClient: AsyncPageIterator)        repeated GET /v1/tracks  CHARGED per page
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    iter(*, limit: int = 100, start_page: int = 1, max_pages: int = 50, max_items: int | None = None,
         max_credits: int | None = None, <every tracks.list filter>, <per-call options>)

  for track in client.tracks.iter(genre="jazz", max_items=1000, max_credits=40): ...
  for page in client.tracks.iter(genre="jazz").pages(): ...
  async for track in async_client.tracks.iter(mood="calm"): ...      # no await before iter()
  Stops when: page * limit >= total, an empty page, max_pages pages fetched, max_items yielded, or the next page would
  exceed max_credits (CreditBudgetExceededError is raised BEFORE that page is sent). Short pages do not stop it.
  max_credits projects each page's cost from your live rate card (it fetches GET /v1/credits, free, when stale).
  The iterator's .spent_projected attribute holds the credits projected so far.
  Iterators are SINGLE-USE. Iterating a consumed iterator (or its .pages()) again raises
  rightsfoundry.IteratorConsumedError (a RightsFoundryError and a RuntimeError) instead of re-sending and re-charging
  every page. Call client.tracks.iter(...) again to walk the results again.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
client.tracks.get(track_id, *, max_credits=None, <per-call options>) -> Track    GET /v1/tracks/{id}   CHARGED
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  track_id: int 1..999_999_999_999_999 or a str of 1–15 ASCII digits (bool, signs, spaces and Unicode digits are
  rejected → InvalidTrackIdError). Cost key: track_detail, charged only when the track exists (404 is free).
  Returns the track plus child_tracks (alternate versions: instrumental, acoustic, …) for parent tracks.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
client.tracks.deep_search(query, *, page=1, limit=20, instrumental=False, max_credits=None, <per-call options>) -> TrackPage
                                                                        POST /v1/tracks/deep-search   CHARGED
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Natural-language brief, results in relevance order. query: str, 1–500 chars after trim, no control chars.
  limit 1–100. instrumental: bool.
  Cost keys: page 1 = deep_search_first_page, charged EVERY time page 1 is sent, even if the result is cached.
  Page >= 2 = deep_search_next_page, at the next-page rate from GET /v1/credits. Ask for a large page once rather than
  re-sending page 1.
  total = candidate-set size (<= 1,000). Each page is a slice of a list cached for 1 hour, and a page can be short.
  Requires the token's Deep Search ability (else FeatureNotEnabledError, feature="deep_search").
  The upstream deadline is 20 s; a 503 SearchUnavailableError is refunded best-effort.

client.tracks.deep_search_iter(query, *, limit=100, instrumental=False, max_pages=50, max_items=None,
                               max_credits=None, timeout=None) -> SyncPageIterator / AsyncPageIterator

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
client.tracks.search_similar(file_url, *, page=1, limit=20, instrumental=False, max_credits=None, <per-call options>) -> TrackPage
                                                                        POST /v1/tracks/search        CHARGED
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Acoustic Similarity Search: tracks that sound like a reference recording. The provider fingerprints the audio.
  file_url rules (validated BEFORE sending, because an unreachable file is charged and not refunded):
    <= 2000 chars; absolute http(s) URL; path ends in .mp3 or .wav (case-insensitive) before ?/#; no userinfo;
    ASCII host (punycode for IDNs); no IP literals in loopback/private/link-local/CGNAT/unique-local ranges, no
    numeric IP encodings; not localhost; no single-label hosts; port in {80, 443, 8080, 8443}. File must be publicly
    reachable and under 120 MB. http:// is allowed but logs one warning per client.
  Cost keys: page 1 = file_search_first_page (every time), page >= 2 = file_search_next_page, at the next-page rate
  from GET /v1/credits.
  Requires the Deep Search ability. Upstream deadline 45 s.
  If the provider cannot fetch/decode the file → UnreachableFileError (400), charge_state="charged" (NOT refunded).

client.tracks.search_similar_iter(file_url, *, limit=100, instrumental=False, max_pages=50, max_items=None,
                                  max_credits=None, timeout=None) -> SyncPageIterator / AsyncPageIterator

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
client.tracks.sync(track_id, *, external_export=False, max_credits=None, <per-call options>) -> SyncLink
                                                                        POST /v1/tracks/{id}/sync     CHARGED (new window)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Mints a signed 1-hour link to the track's WAV master. This is the licence transaction.
  Cost key: sync (standard), or export_sync when external_export=True (Export Sync).
  A repeat request for the same account + track + mode while the window is live is FREE: credits_charged == 0,
  reissued is True, and expires_at is the ORIGINAL expiry (re-requesting never extends access). Standard and Export
  Sync each have their own window. Minting after expiry is charged again.
  Single-flight: concurrent sync() calls for the same (track_id, external_export) on one client share one HTTP
  request. Retry class "sync": ambiguous failures are retried safely (the server serialises windows under a lock).
  Body sent: {"external_export": <bool>}. Requires the Sync ability (else FeatureNotEnabledError, feature="sync").
  Free 404s: TrackNotFoundError, SyncMasterUnavailableError ("No sync master is available for this track").
  The guard projects sync at full price, because the client cannot know whether a window is live.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
client.sync_links.download(link, dest, *, overwrite=False, resume=False, kind="sync", timeout=None) -> pathlib.Path
                                                                        GET <signed URL> on the asset host   FREE
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  link: SyncLink (kind="sync"), Track (kind="preview": downloads the MP3 asset_url), or a signed URL str.
  dest: an existing directory, a path ending in "/" (created with mode 0o700), or a file path whose parent exists.
  When dest is a directory, the file name is the sanitised link.file_name (falls back to "<id>.wav" / "<id>.mp3").
  URL must be https://<asset host>/stream/...?expires=<unix>&sig=<hex> on port 443 with exactly those two query keys,
  no userinfo or fragment, and must not expire within 5 s (else SyncLinkExpiredError; minting a new link after
  expiry is charged again). Asset hosts come from the asset_hosts option (default ["assets.therightsfoundry.com"]).
  Sends NO Authorization, custom headers or cookies. Redirects are never followed. Streams in 64 KiB chunks to an
  exclusively created 0600 temp file, bounded by max_download_bytes (2 GiB), then fsyncs and renames atomically.
  Refuses symlinks. An existing file is kept unless overwrite=True. resume=True continues a partial download with an
  HTTP Range request (validated against Content-Range). The hidden partial file is keyed by a hash of the URL path, so
  a different track never appends onto another's partial; if a ranged resume fails, the SDK truncates the partial and
  retries once with a full GET.
  Asset-host errors: 403 "URL has expired" → SyncLinkExpiredError; 400/403 → SyncLinkInvalidError;
  404 → SyncMasterUnavailableError (not retried); 408/429/5xx retried up to max_retries.
  kind="preview": preview streams are intended to be billed at costs.stream from API credits in a future update
  (metered today, not yet deducted).

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
client.taxonomies.list(*, <per-call options>) -> Taxonomies             GET /v1/taxonomies      FREE
client.credits.retrieve(*, <per-call options>) -> Credits                GET /v1/credits         FREE, unmetered
client.health.check(*, <per-call options>) -> HealthStatus               GET /v1/health          FREE, no key sent
client.health.live(*, <per-call options>) -> LivenessStatus              GET /v1/health/live     FREE, no key sent
client.health.ready(*, <per-call options>) -> ReadinessStatus            GET /v1/health/ready    FREE, no key sent
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  taxonomies: values in every facet, ordered by count desc. Each value is an exact-match term for tracks.list.
  Cached in-process only when taxonomies_cache_ttl_ms > 0.
  credits.retrieve(): also refreshes the client's credit guard (rate card and balance snapshot).
  health: a 503 "degraded"/"not ready" answer is RETURNED as a value (check .healthy / .alive / .ready). Only an
  inability to reach the API raises HealthCheckError. Health probes default to max_retries=0, so a degraded 503 returns
  HealthStatus(status="degraded") immediately; pass max_retries=2 to retry it.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
client.request(method, path, *, query=None, json=None, options=None, timeout=None, max_credits=None,
               idempotency_key=None) -> Any
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Low-level escape hatch for endpoints added to the API before an SDK release. It goes through the full pipeline
  (auth, guards, retries, redaction, bounded reads) and returns parsed JSON: objects, arrays and primitives are
  returned as they are, and a 204 or an empty 2xx body returns None. options= takes a CallOptions.
  method: GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE/HEAD. path must start with /v1/, use only [A-Za-z0-9/_-], and contain no "..",
  "//", %2e, %2f or backslash. Admin paths (/v1/admin…, /v1/health/admin) are refused.
  query: a mapping of name ([A-Za-z0-9_]{1,64}) to str/int/float/bool. json: a mapping (strict JSON).
  Known endpoints keep their cost key and retry class. Unknown endpoints use cost key "unknown" and the
  conservative "charged" retry class, so a guard in closed mode refuses them when a cap is set.
  idempotency_key: 1–255 printable ASCII characters without spaces, sent as an Idempotency-Key header. With a key,
  ambiguous outcomes are retried (section 7). This is forward-compatible: the API does not honour idempotency keys yet.

======================================================================================================================
3. MODELS (frozen dataclasses; every model has .raw — a deep read-only view of the original JSON — and .to_dict())
======================================================================================================================

Unknown fields never raise and are kept in .raw. Enums are open (typed as str), so an unknown value never raises.
Signed URLs are intact on the model, but every repr redacts their sig. Models pickle and copy.deepcopy cleanly (for
multiprocessing, Celery, caches). .raw is an immutable read-only mapping: str()/repr() redact signed-URL sig values,
while indexing still returns the real value.

Track
  id: int · title, artist, performed_by, album: str|None · duration: float|None (seconds) · bpm: float|None ·
  musical_key, decades, vocals: str|None · explicit: bool|None · first_published, release_date: str|None ·
  asset_url: str|None (signed MP3 preview, 1 h) · peak_data_url: str|None (signed waveform data, 1 h) ·
  genres, sub_genres, moods, instruments, sub_instruments, themes, sub_themes: tuple[str, ...] (editorial tags) ·
  AI musical analysis (all may be None): main_genre, subgenre, free_genre, mood_simple, mood_advanced, character,
  movement, instruments_detected, music_for, vocals_detected, vocal_style: tuple[str, ...]|None ·
  vocal_presence, vocal_gender, key, tempo, time_signature, energy_level, emotion_profile, musical_era,
  auto_description, tag_source, tagged_at: str|None · voiceover_degree, bpm_confidence, key_confidence, valence,
  arousal, ai_music_score, bpm_detected: float|None · voiceover_dominant, is_ai_music: bool|None ·
  production_year: int|None ·
  has_alternatives: bool|None · term_matches: int|None (lexical search only) · child_tracks: tuple[Track, ...] (get() only)
  Methods: redacted_asset_url() -> str|None

TrackPage   (iterating a page iterates .data; len(page) == len(page.data))
  data: tuple[Track, ...] · total: int · page: int · limit: int · request_id: str|None ·
  retried_after_refundable_failure: bool ·
  search metadata (tracks.list with a non-empty search only): matched: tuple[SearchMatch] · unmatched_terms:
  tuple[str] · corrections: tuple[SearchCorrection] · relaxed: bool|None · coverage: SearchCoverage|None ·
  ignored_terms: tuple[str] · hint: str|None ·
  constraints: SearchConstraints|None (set whenever a hard constraint was applied)
  Methods: has_next_page() -> bool (page * limit < total and data non-empty)
SearchMatch: term, field, value: str; partial: bool
SearchCorrection: from_: str (wire "from"), to: str
SearchCoverage: terms: int; levels: tuple[CoverageLevel(matched: int, rows: int)]
SearchConstraints: vocals, key: str|None; bpm: tuple[float, float]|None; duration: DurationConstraint|None
  (min, max: float|None; widened: bool); empty_because: tuple[EmptyConstraintReason(constraint: str,
  rows_without: int, rows_with: int|None)] (which constraint to loosen when nothing matched)

SyncLink
  id: int · title, artist: str|None · format: str ("wav") · file_name: str · download_url: str (bearer capability) ·
  expires_at: str (ISO 8601) · expires_in: int (seconds) · credits_charged: int · reissued: bool ·
  external_export: bool · billing: SyncBilling(charged_on: str|None ("api_call"), note: str|None) ·
  request_id: str|None · retried_after_refundable_failure: bool
  Properties/methods: expires_at_datetime -> datetime|None (aware UTC) · redacted_download_url() -> str

Taxonomies
  genre, mood, theme, instrument, character, movement, vocals, tempo, energy, era, decade, key:
  tuple[TaxonomyItem(value: str, count: int), ...] · facets: Mapping[str, tuple[TaxonomyItem]] (every facet returned,
  including ones added later) · request_id
  Methods: get(facet) -> tuple[TaxonomyItem] · values(facet) -> list[str]

Credits
  as_of: str · balance_source: str ("live" | "database") ·
  api_credits: CreditBalance(balance: int, overdraft_limit: int, spendable: int)   # spendable = balance + overdraft
  bandwidth_bytes: BandwidthBalance(balance, overdraft_limit, spendable: int) ·
  expiring_credits: tuple[ExpiringBatch(api_credits: int, bandwidth_bytes: int, expires_at: str)] ·
  costs: Mapping[str, int]  (YOUR live rate card, with plan discounts applied; the only correct input for budgeting) ·
  standard_costs: Mapping[str, int] · discounts: Mapping[str, PlanDiscount(standard: int, plan_id: int|None, plan: str)] ·
  subscription: SubscriptionInfo(plan_id: int, plan: str)|None ·
  token: TokenUsage(name, public_code: str|None, api_calls_month: int, bandwidth_month_bytes: int,
         month_reset_at, expires_at: str|None, daily_call_limit: int|None) · request_id

HealthStatus: success: bool, status: str ("healthy"|"degraded"), http_status: int, version, environment, timestamp:
  str|None, uptime: float|None, database: DatabaseCheck(status, latency: str|None, latency_ms: float|None)|None,
  retry_after: float|None, request_id; property healthy
LivenessStatus: success, status ("alive"), http_status, request_id; property alive
ReadinessStatus: success, status ("ready"|"not ready"), http_status, database, billing: BillingCheck(status,
  required: bool|None, mode: str|None)|None, retry_after, request_id; property ready

Hook events (immutable, already redacted):
  RequestEvent: operation, sdk_call_id (UUID, constant across retries, never sent), attempt (1-based), method, url
    (sig redacted), headers (Authorization → "Bearer [REDACTED fp=…]"), cost_key, projected_credits, body
    (only with hook_include_bodies=True; redacted, <= 64 KiB)
  ResponseEvent: operation, sdk_call_id, attempt, method, url, status, headers (allowlisted: content-type,
    content-length, content-encoding, x-request-id, retry-after, cache-control, cf-ray, date), request_id,
    duration_ms, will_retry, retry_in_ms, cost_key, projected_credits, body
  ErrorEvent: operation, sdk_call_id, attempt, method, url, error (redacted typed error), charge_state, status,
    request_id, duration_ms, will_retry, retry_in_ms, cost_key, projected_credits
  LowCreditEvent: spendable: int, balance, overdraft_limit: int|None, threshold: int, source ("credits" |
    "insufficient_credits" | "estimate" | "response_header"), as_of, token_public_code

Other exports: CallOptions (per-call options, section 2), Secret (redacting key wrapper: .fingerprint, .redacted()),
ClientConfig, NOT_GIVEN/NotGiven,
SyncPageIterator, AsyncPageIterator, ENDPOINTS (read-only endpoint registry), PUBLIC_COST_KEYS, EndpointSpec,
OperationSpec, Transport, AsyncTransport, HTTPTransport, AsyncExecutorTransport, PreparedRequest, RawResponse,
AsyncRawResponse, Headers, __version__.

======================================================================================================================
4. BILLING AND CREDITS
======================================================================================================================

Audio route         | Getting the link                                              | Moving the bytes
WAV master (sync)   | CHARGED at sync / export_sync for a new 1-hour window;        | FREE: download as often as you like
                    | reissues inside the paid window are free                      | while the link is valid
MP3 preview         | FREE: comes with the listing/search/detail call you paid for  | Intended to be billed per stream
(asset_url)         |                                                               | (costs.stream) from API credits in a
                    |                                                               | future update (metered today, not
                    |                                                               | yet deducted)

Public cost keys (client.credits.retrieve().costs; rightsfoundry.PUBLIC_COST_KEYS):
  tracks_list                GET /v1/tracks without a non-empty search (any page)
  tracks_search_first_page   GET /v1/tracks with search, page 1
  tracks_search_next_page    GET /v1/tracks with search, page >= 2
  track_detail               GET /v1/tracks/{id} (only when the track exists)
  deep_search_first_page     POST /v1/tracks/deep-search, page 1 (every time it is sent)
  deep_search_next_page      POST /v1/tracks/deep-search, page >= 2
  file_search_first_page     POST /v1/tracks/search, page 1 (every time it is sent)
  file_search_next_page      POST /v1/tracks/search, page >= 2
  sync                       POST /v1/tracks/{id}/sync, new standard window
  export_sync                POST /v1/tracks/{id}/sync with external_export=true, new Export Sync window
  stream                     preview playback; intended to be billed from API credits in a future update (metered
                             today, not yet deducted)
Free: GET /v1/taxonomies, GET /v1/credits (also uncounted), health, signed-URL downloads, sync reissues in the window.

Balances are per account: every token on the account shares one pool. spendable = balance + overdraft_limit, and the
balance may go negative within the overdraft. 402 InsufficientCreditsError when the cost would exceed the overdraft
floor. Top up at https://therightsfoundry.com/dashboard/billing.

What each licence grants (summary only; https://therightsfoundry.com/licensing is authoritative):
  Stream/preview (asset_url): a single-time stream, or use to preview a potential sync licence.
  Standard sync (tracks.sync(id)): one-time synchronization of the track and use of the resulting content on online
    third-party platforms, without monetization.
  Export Sync (tracks.sync(id, external_export=True)): standard sync, plus use of the synced output or audio file
    offline, or placing/exporting/distributing it outside the platform (client delivery, broadcast, social media,
    offline playback).
  No licence includes AI/ML training rights (see https://therightsfoundry.com/licensed-ai-training-data).

======================================================================================================================
5. CREDIT GUARDRAILS (client-side, advisory; the server's 402 is the authority)
======================================================================================================================

Projection: the SDK reads costs from GET /v1/credits (free), caches it for rate_card_ttl_ms (60 s), and picks the
same cost key the server will. If the rate card has no price for the key, the projection is "unknown".
- max_credits_per_request (client) / max_credits= (per call; replaces the client cap for that call):
    projected > cap → CreditCapExceededError(projected, cap, cost_key). Nothing is sent.
- guard_failure_mode="closed" (default): rate card unreadable or price unknown while a cap/preflight is active →
    CreditGuardUnavailableError. "open": log a warning and proceed.
- auto_check_credits=True: before each charged call, refresh the balance snapshot if older than credit_check_ttl_ms
    (30 s), estimate spendable − Σ projected spend since the snapshot, and raise PreflightInsufficientCreditsError
    (resource="api_credits") if the call would take it below 0. min_bandwidth_bytes adds a floor on
    bandwidth_bytes.spendable (resource="bandwidth").
- low_credit_warning_threshold + on_low_credit(event: LowCreditEvent): edge-triggered (fires once per drop below the
    threshold, re-arms after an observation at or above it). Observations come from credits.retrieve(), 402 bodies and
    (with auto_check_credits) local estimates. Without a callback it logs a warning. Callback exceptions are logged,
    never raised. Do not do slow work inline.
- Iterators: max_credits is a budget for the whole walk → CreditBudgetExceededError(spent_projected, next_cost, cap,
    cost_key) before the page that would exceed it.

======================================================================================================================
6. ERRORS
======================================================================================================================

Every error subclasses rightsfoundry.RightsFoundryError and has: message, status, request_id, operation,
server_error, server_message, body (redacted parsed JSON), charge_state, retry_after (seconds), attempts, code.
str(err) includes request_id. Errors hold only redacted data and can be pickled (redacted state only).

RightsFoundryError
├── ConfigurationError                     invalid option at construction                          not_charged
├── ValidationError                        client-side input check failed; nothing sent            not_charged
│   └── InvalidTrackIdError
├── IteratorConsumedError                  a single-use page iterator was iterated again (also RuntimeError)
├── CreditGuardError                       client-side guard tripped; nothing sent                 not_charged
│   ├── CreditCapExceededError             .projected .cap .cost_key
│   ├── CreditBudgetExceededError          .spent_projected .next_cost .cap .cost_key
│   ├── PreflightInsufficientCreditsError  .projected .api_credits / .bandwidth_bytes .resource
│   └── CreditGuardUnavailableError
├── APIConnectionError                     DNS/refused/reset/TLS; .phase connect|write|read        connect → not_charged; else unknown
│   ├── APITimeoutError                    .phase connect|read|write|total
│   └── TLSVerificationError               certificate/hostname failure; NEVER retried             not_charged
├── ResponseTooLargeError                  .max_bytes .observed_bytes
├── UnexpectedRedirectError                any 3xx; never followed; .location (redacted)
├── UnexpectedResponseError                non-JSON or wrong shape (e.g. an edge HTML 502)
├── APIStatusError                         non-2xx JSON from the API
│   ├── BadRequestError                    400                                                     not_charged
│   │   └── UnreachableFileError           400 "Could not download or decode the audio at file_url.   CHARGED (no refund)
│   │                                      It must be a publicly reachable .mp3 or .wav under 120MB."
│   ├── AuthenticationError                401 "Missing authorization header"                      not_charged
│   ├── InsufficientCreditsError           402 "Insufficient credits. Please top up to continue."  not_charged
│   │                                      .api_credits .bandwidth_bytes (balance before the refused charge)
│   ├── PermissionDeniedError              403                                                     not_charged
│   │   ├── InvalidTokenError              "Invalid API token" (also: a key from the other environment)
│   │   ├── InactiveTokenError             "API token is inactive"
│   │   ├── ExpiredTokenError              "API token has expired" (MCP connections only)
│   │   └── FeatureNotEnabledError         .feature "deep_search": "Deep Search is not enabled for this API token.
│   │                                        Contact support to enable it." / "sync": "Sync licensing is not enabled
│   │                                        for this API token. Contact support to enable it."
│   ├── NotFoundError                      404 (also "Account not found", "Not found")             not_charged
│   │   ├── TrackNotFoundError             "Track not found"
│   │   └── SyncMasterUnavailableError     "No sync master is available for this track" / asset-host 404
│   ├── MethodNotAllowedError              405 (an SDK bug if ever seen)                           not_charged
│   ├── GoneError                          410 retired endpoint (only via client.request)          not_charged
│   ├── RateLimitError                     429 .retry_after                                        not_charged
│   │   └── DailyCallLimitError            "Daily call limit reached for this connection. It resets at 00:00 UTC."
│   │                                      .limit .reset_at (MCP connections only; dashboard keys have no cap)
│   ├── InternalServerError                500 "Internal server error"; .refund_pending             refund_pending (charged ops)
│   └── ServiceUnavailableError            503 .retry_after
│       ├── BillingUnavailableError        "Billing is temporarily unavailable. Please retry shortly."   not_charged
│       │                                  (request not served; a pending deduction is cancelled; the API docs call
│       │                                   this "deduction unconfirmed": check credits.retrieve() if it matters)
│       └── SearchUnavailableError         "Search is temporarily unavailable, please retry."      refund_pending
├── SyncLinkError                          asset-host failure during download                      not_charged
│   ├── SyncLinkExpiredError               link expired (re-minting after expiry is charged again)
│   └── SyncLinkInvalidError               malformed / not allowlisted / 403 Invalid signature / 400 Missing signature parameters
└── HealthCheckError                       health probe could not reach the API (a 503 answer is a value, not this)

Other 400 messages (all BadRequestError, not charged): "limit must be an integer", "limit must be at least 1",
"page must be an integer", "page must be at least 1", "Invalid track ID", "Request body must be valid JSON",
"query is required", "query is no longer supported on this endpoint; use POST /v1/tracks/deep-search",
"file_url is required", "file_url must be a valid URL", "file_url must be an http(s) URL",
"file_url must point to an .mp3 or .wav file", and "Bad Request" with a message detail on the sync body.
Classification: an exact (status, error text) match, then a fallback to the status family. An unknown 403 message
becomes PermissionDeniedError, never a generic error. Free operations (credits, taxonomies, health) always report
not_charged. Read-phase failures, 408, 502 and 504 on charged operations report "unknown".

======================================================================================================================
7. RETRIES
======================================================================================================================

Retry classes: "free" (taxonomies, credits, health), "sync" (tracks.sync), "charged" (list, get, deep_search,
search_similar, and unknown request() paths). The API does not honour idempotency keys yet, and charged routes charge
before doing the work.

Outcome                                   | free  | sync  | charged + refund_backed (default) | never | always
Connect failure (request never written)   | retry | retry | retry                             | retry | retry
429                                       | retry*| retry*| retry*                            | retry*| retry*
503 billing unavailable (not served)      | retry | retry | retry                             | no    | retry
503 search unavailable (refunded)         |   –   |   –   | retry                             | no    | retry
500 (refund queued)                       | retry | retry | retry                             | no    | retry
408 / 502 / 504 (unknown)                 | retry | retry | NO (retry with idempotency_key)   | no    | retry
Read timeout / reset after send           | retry | retry | NO (retry with idempotency_key)   | no    | retry
* only if Retry-After <= max_retry_after_ms (30 s default); otherwise the typed error is raised with .retry_after.
idempotency_key=: when a key is supplied, ambiguous outcomes (408, 502, 504, read-phase connection failures) are
retried even under "refund_backed", so the call gets full retry safety as soon as the API honours the header. Today the
server ignores it, so such a retry can still be charged twice; reconcile with credits.retrieve() if that matters.
max_retries= per call replaces the client's max_retries. Health probes default to max_retries=0.
Never retried: 400, 401, 402, 403, 404, 405, 410, TLSVerificationError, ResponseTooLargeError, UnexpectedRedirectError,
any ValidationError/CreditGuardError.
Backoff for attempt n: base = min(retry_max_delay_ms, retry_initial_delay_ms * 2^(n-1)); jitter "full" =
uniform(0, base) (CSPRNG), "equal" = base/2 + uniform(0, base/2), "none" = base. Never sooner than Retry-After
(delta-seconds or IMF-fixdate). Stops early if total_timeout would be exceeded. Defaults: max_retries=2, 500 ms → 8 s.
A success that follows a refundable failure sets retried_after_refundable_failure=True on TrackPage/SyncLink.

======================================================================================================================
8. CONFIGURATION (keyword > environment variable (read once) > default; all validated at construction)
======================================================================================================================

api_key                    TRF_API_KEY                   required (except unauthenticated()); 128 hex chars, trimmed, lowercased.
                                                         A 4-char public code is rejected with a hint. api_key=None does NOT read the env.
environment                TRF_ENVIRONMENT               "production" (default) | "staging"
base_url                   TRF_BASE_URL                  https only; host must be api.therightsfoundry.com, api-staging.therightsfoundry.com,
                                                         or match allowed_hosts; no IP literals, userinfo, query or fragment
allowed_hosts              (code only)                   extra gateway hosts (exact, or one leading "*." label)
asset_hosts                (code only)                   default ("assets.therightsfoundry.com",)
ca_bundle                  TRF_CA_BUNDLE                 readable PEM file trusted instead of the system store; verification stays on
proxy_url                  HTTPS_PROXY / NO_PROXY        http:// or https:// CONNECT proxy (https: TLS to the proxy, then CONNECT, then
                                                         TLS to the API); credentials redacted everywhere. Other schemes (socks5://, …)
                                                         raise ConfigurationError naming the source (proxy_url or HTTPS_PROXY)
connect_timeout            TRF_CONNECT_TIMEOUT           10 s (0.1–120)
read_timeout               TRF_READ_TIMEOUT              60 s (1–600), idle time per read
write_timeout              –                             30 s (1–600)
total_timeout              –                             None; >= read_timeout when set; wall clock across attempts
max_retries                TRF_MAX_RETRIES               2 (0–10)
retry_initial_delay_ms     –                             500 (50–60000)
retry_max_delay_ms         –                             8000 (>= initial, <= 300000)
jitter                     –                             "full" | "equal" | "none"
max_retry_after_ms         –                             30000 (0–600000)
retryable_status_codes     –                             (408, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504); 400–407 and 409–428 are refused
charged_retry_policy       –                             "refund_backed" | "never" | "always"
max_credits_per_request    TRF_MAX_CREDITS_PER_REQUEST   None (>= 0)
low_credit_warning_threshold TRF_LOW_CREDIT_WARNING_THRESHOLD  None (any int; negative allowed for overdraft)
on_low_credit              –                             callable(LowCreditEvent)
auto_check_credits         TRF_AUTO_CHECK_CREDITS        False (env: true/false/1/0 only)
credit_check_ttl_ms        –                             30000 (1000–3600000)
rate_card_ttl_ms           –                             60000 (1000–3600000)
guard_failure_mode         –                             "closed" | "open"
min_bandwidth_bytes        –                             None
on_request/on_response/on_error  –                       callables(event); synchronous; exceptions logged, not raised
hook_include_bodies        –                             False
custom_headers             –                             X-[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64} (except X-Admin-Token, X-API-Key, X-Forwarded-*, X-Real-IP,
                                                         X-Request-Id, X-Original-*, X-Http-Method-Override, X-Middleware-*) or
                                                         traceparent/tracestate/baggage; values printable ASCII <= 1024 bytes; API host only
user_agent_suffix          TRF_USER_AGENT_SUFFIX         printable ASCII product tokens <= 128 chars
transport / async_transport  –                           custom Transport / AsyncTransport (see docs/architecture.md)
logger                     TRF_LOG                       logging.Logger; TRF_LOG = off|error|warn|info|debug
max_connections            –                             10 (1–256)
max_response_bytes         –                             10 MiB (64 KiB–100 MiB)
max_download_bytes         –                             2 GiB (>= 1 MiB)
max_concurrency            –                             None; limits in-flight requests per AsyncClient
taxonomies_cache_ttl_ms    –                             0 (off; up to 86400000)
allow_insecure_localhost   (code only)                   http:// to localhost/127.0.0.1/[::1], only when environment != "production"
dangerously_allow_browser  (code only)                   False; Pyodide/WASM is refused unless True (do not set it)
No environment variable can enable http://, add an allowed host, make a guard fail open, or weaken TLS.

======================================================================================================================
9. SECURITY RULES (summary of SEC-01..SEC-20)
======================================================================================================================

- Zero runtime dependencies. Standard library only.
- TLS 1.2+, CERT_REQUIRED, hostname checking, with the SDK's own SSLContext. There is no verify=False.
- Redirects are never followed (UnexpectedRedirectError), so the key cannot be carried to another host.
- The key is wrapped in Secret: repr/str/format show "[REDACTED fp=xxxxxxxx]", pickling raises, comparison is
  constant-time. fp = first 8 hex chars of sha256("rightsfoundry-key-fp:" + key), the same value
  /dashboard/token shows.
- Everything that reaches logs, hooks or exceptions is redacted: Authorization values, the key, any 128+ hex run,
  sig= query values, URL userinfo, and "Bearer <token>" text.
- Track IDs: ASCII digits only, 1–15. Query parameters are allowlisted and typed. JSON bodies are built from typed
  fields only.
- Bounded response bodies (decompressed bytes counted), JSON depth <= 64, NaN/Infinity rejected.
- Downloads: allowlisted host, https, port 443, /stream/ path, exactly expires+sig, no credentials, atomic 0600
  writes, symlinks refused.
- Fork-safe connection pool. CSPRNG jitter. Monotonic deadlines. No telemetry.
- In your application: keep the key on the server, never in browser/mobile code. Read it from a secret manager for
  long-running services. Never log signed URLs. Never paste keys or signed URLs into issues or prompts.

======================================================================================================================
10. COPY-PASTE PATTERNS
======================================================================================================================

# --- Brief → license → download (sync) ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
import rightsfoundry

with rightsfoundry.Client(max_credits_per_request=100) as client:
    costs = client.credits.retrieve().costs                       # free
    results = client.tracks.deep_search("warm hopeful acoustic guitar", limit=20, instrumental=True)
    if results.data:
        track = results.data[0]
        link = client.tracks.sync(track.id)                         # charged at costs["sync"] (0 if reissued)
        path = client.sync_links.download(link, "./masters/")       # free
        print(track.title, link.credits_charged, link.redacted_download_url(), path)

# --- Same, async -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
import asyncio
import rightsfoundry

async def main() -> None:
    async with rightsfoundry.AsyncClient(max_credits_per_request=100) as client:
        results = await client.tracks.deep_search("tense heist build-up", limit=20)
        if results.data:
            link = await client.tracks.sync(results.data[0].id)
            await client.sync_links.download(link, "./masters/")
        async for t in client.tracks.iter(mood="calm", max_items=200, max_credits=10):
            print(t.id, t.title)

asyncio.run(main())

# --- Error handling with charge state --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
import rightsfoundry as rf

try:
    page = client.tracks.search_similar("https://cdn.example.com/temp-track.mp3", max_credits=20)
except rf.ValidationError as e:              # bad URL caught locally: nothing sent, nothing charged
    print("fix the URL:", e)
except rf.UnreachableFileError as e:          # charged, not refunded
    print("provider could not fetch the file; charge_state =", e.charge_state, "request", e.request_id)
except rf.InsufficientCreditsError as e:
    print("top up; balance was", e.api_credits)
except rf.APIStatusError as e:
    print(e.status, e.charge_state, e.request_id)

# --- Budgeted export ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
it = client.tracks.iter(genre="ambient", max_items=500, max_credits=20)
try:
    for t in it:
        save(t.id, t.title, t.genres)
except rf.CreditBudgetExceededError as e:
    print("budget reached; next page would cost", e.next_cost)

# --- Server endpoint returning only safe fields to a browser -------------------------------------------------------
def to_browser(t: rf.Track) -> dict:
    return {"id": t.id, "title": t.title, "artist": t.artist, "duration": t.duration, "preview_url": t.asset_url}

# --- Health without a key ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
status = rf.Client.unauthenticated().health.check()
print(status.healthy, status.http_status)

======================================================================================================================
11. CLI AND GITHUB ACTION
======================================================================================================================

CLI (key from TRF_API_KEY only; --json for raw JSON, ASCII-escaped; --environment staging). Global flags work before
or after the subcommand:
  rightsfoundry health [--mode check|live|ready]
  rightsfoundry credits
  rightsfoundry taxonomies [--facet NAME]
  rightsfoundry search [QUERY] [--genre --mood --instrument --theme --vocals --key --bpm-min --bpm-max
                       --duration-min --duration-max --page --limit --max-credits]
  rightsfoundry deep-search QUERY [--limit --page --instrumental --max-credits]
  rightsfoundry similar FILE_URL [--limit --page --instrumental --max-credits]
  rightsfoundry track ID
  rightsfoundry sync ID [--external-export --download DIR_OR_FILE --overwrite --max-credits]
  Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 API/network error, 2 usage/validation/guard error, 3 health not healthy.

GitHub Action: uses: therightsfoundry/trf-python@v1 (pin to a commit SHA in production). Needs Python >= 3.9 on the
  runner and runs it in isolated mode (python3 -I), so nothing in the checked-out workspace can be imported.
  inputs: action (deep-search|search|search-similar|track|sync|credits|health), api-key (from secrets), environment,
  query, track-id, file-url, genre, mood, instrument, vocals, bpm-min, bpm-max, duration-min, duration-max,
  instrumental, limit (default 20), external-export, download-path, max-credits
  outputs: result-json (sig redacted), track-id, track-title, track-artist, downloaded-file, credits-charged,
  credits-spendable, request-id
  See https://github.com/therightsfoundry/trf-python/blob/main/docs/github-action.md

======================================================================================================================
12. AGENTS AND MCP
======================================================================================================================

MCP connector: https://mcp.therightsfoundry.com/mcp (remote, OAuth sign-in with the user's Rights Foundry account;
the agent never handles an API key). Server card: https://mcp.therightsfoundry.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
Use the SDK instead when you run your own backend or agent loop. Tool schemas and safety rules:
https://github.com/therightsfoundry/trf-python/blob/main/docs/llm-and-mcp-guide.md
Builder overview: https://therightsfoundry.com/for-builders (cleared, human-made music for apps, agents and pipelines)

Support: https://docs.therightsfoundry.com/ · info@therightsfoundry.com · security: security@therightsfoundry.com
